meuTurno.texto: Your home during the shift: assigned patients, overdue doses and reassessments, and alerts per patient.

mar.texto: All doses for the shift. Always administer here: it identifies the patient, shows allergies and asks for the five rights.

passagem.texto: ISBAR per patient, built from what was recorded. The receiver confirms.

tarefas.texto: What you have to do this shift, including tasks created by assessments (nutrition, fall prevention…).

doentes.texto: Your patients. The file has tabs (V vitals, M medication, N notes) and allergies always on top.

worklist.texto: Tests with results ready to validate.

farmacia.texto: Stock, ward requests and, in the Validation tab, prescriptions to validate before dispensing.

farmaciaClinica.texto: Medication review, interactions and dose adjustment.

recepcao.texto: Service queue and quick patient registration.

registos.texto: New patient with duplicate detection; for patients without ID, use "Unidentified patient".

camas.texto: Real-time bed map, bed requests and expected discharges.

executivo.texto: Occupancy, inpatients, emergency and hospital indicators, with one definition across screens.

qualidade.texto: Nursing indicators, infection control and adverse events.

paleta.texto: Find a patient, open a page or, inside the file, jump straight to vitals or medication.

bloquear.texto: Stepping away briefly? Lock it (Ctrl+Shift+L): your session stays open and the screen is protected.

ajuda.texto: Shortcuts, this tour, first steps and what is new — always here, or with the "?" key.
